response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM g) SELECT SUM(g.cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(g.share) AS avg_share, AVG(g.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM g, a WHERE g.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes with NULL powerstatus form one group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together). Empty-string statuses are treated as a separate, non-missing value.
Share = group count / total telescopes in the telescopes table. The average share is the unweighted mean across status groups, including the NULL group.
If no group has a share above the average (all equal), the query returns one row with NULLs.
